provenance.origin: Original artwork generated for Vo Lam Hero Defense with OpenAI ImageGen and assembled in Aseprite 1.3.18.6
provenance.promptDirection: Isolated six-cel pixel-fire sequences on solid black in a 3 by 2 grid. Sharp vermilion and gold silhouettes, consistent contact pivot, no bloom.

bolt_flight.promptDirection: Compact right-facing compressed fire bolt with a bright almond tip and short double tail. Cycle the flame tongues around a fixed tip.

phoenix_flight.promptDirection: One fire phoenix with a fixed right-facing beak, broad wings that draw in then reopen, and an undulating flame tail.

bolt_hit.promptDirection: Compact directional flash at contact, followed by a short burst and diminishing copper sparks.

phoenix_hit.promptDirection: Flash at beak contact, two splayed fans of flame separate and shed feather-shaped embers.
